verdict_detail:
S3-Simplified PASSES the gauntlet on all 4 checks when using the
5-day time-stop as the SOLE exit (no intra-hold stop):
  net +156 bps/trade | net_exc +15.6 bps | Sharpe +0.122 | p_bonf 3.013e-02

HOWEVER: the -2% project stop from CLAUDE.md is INCOMPATIBLE with
gap-strategy entries. Applied correctly (vs T+1 open), it triggers on
77% of trades and kills the edge
(net excess -97 bps, Sharpe -1.011).

CRO EXCEPTION REQUIRED: the -2% stop must be either:
  (a) waived for gap-entry trades (use time-stop only), OR
  (b) redefined as ≥ gap_magnitude from the PRIOR close
      (i.e., stop only triggers if the gap itself fully reverses)

Until the exception is granted and codified, S3 is approved ONLY
for paper trading with 5-day time-stop as the sole exit.
stop_incompatibility_finding: The project -2% stop (CLAUDE.md) is structurally incompatible with gap strategies. Entry is at T+1 open, already 5-8% above the prior close. A -2% stop from this elevated entry hits on 77.3% of trades. The edge exists in the 5-day trajectory from the gapped-up/down entry, not in the tight per-bar drawdown control the -2% rule was designed for.
